zh: 优化 Agent 交互式登录命令识别，支持多行脚本换行及条件分支（||）后的登录命令。
自动剔除可能误杀进程的 pkill 命令段，终端标签页顶部增加授权指引并在失败时明确反馈。
增强交互式终端在模型重试与连续登录步骤下的运行稳定性。
en: Improved Agent interactive login detection to reliably handle multi-line scripts and conditional chains (||).
Automatically drop self-killing pkill commands, add an authorization banner in interactive tabs, and return clear failure feedback.
Enhanced interactive terminal stability during model retries and multi-step logins.
